Our score of 43 points gave us a reasonably easy win over Woodford Green A.C., and we regained our hold on the "Edward Knott Memorial Shield." Third were Leicester W.C., and the promoters, Surrey Walking Club, fourth. E.
Thaxter is young in walking experience and is to be congratulated upon an excellent performance. Our team was completed by E.
Jack Rutland (R.A.P.C.) audits Army accounts somewhere in the Midlands; and Len Coleman instructs Army cooks on how to cook! A former champion, E.
Ernest Reeve, one of our walkers of bygone years, from Chelmsford, went to France, came back via Dunkirk, and is now in Shropshire with the R.E.M.E.
LEFT: Harold King (left), first winner of the "A.J. SAWYER" Cup, in action with E.L. Reeve during a road race.
